description: This file defines the ElvisBinary class, a custom binary expression node for Twig templates that implements the Elvis operator ( ?: ). It extends the AbstractBinary class and is used to generate PHP code that evaluates a ternary expression with a specific syntax in the Twig templating engine.

classes.name: ElvisBinary
classes.description: A class representing a binary expression node implementing the Elvis operator ( ?: ) in Twig templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ElvisBinary node with left and right expressions and the line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the Elvis operator expression during compilation.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string '?:' as the operator representation.

methods.name: getOperandNamesToEscape
methods.description: Returns the names of operand nodes ('left' and 'right') that should be escaped.
